goal: Wave 1 build: Revisions, decide and undo; Do loop: attachments on RunAgentRequest, images in the Do seed

slices.title: Revisions, decide and undo
slices.summary: Records every skill change from any writer in a trigger-written revision log that carries the actor, and lets only the owner accept, reject or undo a learned skill, with undo restoring the before-snapshot and an owner-scoped ledger read.
test_commands: GUC naming pinned by a test

decisions_defaults.DEC-30: Preference in session-core `user_memory_controls`; org policy in org-core `metadata.agentLearning` (memory allow; `learningReview` DISABLED = opt-in). Learned skills: `scope=user`, `enabled=false`, `review_state='proposed'`, owner accepts; no auto-accept until
decisions_defaults.DEC-32: A waived run counts as ZDR for every NEW durable store this program adds and for background jobs; it keeps only what Ask already persists for that connection; recall and fork refuse waived content. Waiver minting stays OFF (`ZDR_WAIVER_ENABLED`).
decisions_defaults.DEC-39: Integrator reserves (section 2.6 row 1). Land the live ZDR + session-core wave (WS01 S0) before anyone edits `grpc.rs`, `auth.rs`, `sessions.proto`. CI: drop `branches` filters on `pull_request`, add integration branch to `push`. Add matrix row + CODEOWNERS fo

slices.title: Do loop: attachments on RunAgentRequest, images in the Do seed
slices.summary: Adds repeated RunAttachment attachments = 20 to RunAgentRequest and carries validated attachments through the Do run: a sandbox note in the seed, images as image_parts on every InferRequest of the run, a run-scoped RunInputs guard released on terminal or cancel, and no inheritance by subagent children. Behind CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED (default off); checkpoints never hold attachment bytes.
